company.summary: COMPASS GROUP NORGE AS is a private limited company (aksjeselskap) registered under kantinedrift og annen cateringvirksomhet (NACE 56.220), based in Oslo, founded 1989-06-29. Its verified website describes it as: “Compass Group er verdens ledende totalleverandør av driftstjenester til både offentlige og private organisasjoner. Vi tilbyr mat, renhold og andre tjenester for eiendomsforvaltning, bedrifter, helse, camps og offshore.” Registered activity: Drift av kantinen - og alt som står i forbindelse med dette - herunder å delta i andre selskaper. Latest filed accounts (2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30, company accounts): revenue NOK 2.2 bn, operating result NOK 53.7 m, net result NOK 45.3 m, total assets NOK 1.3 bn, equity NOK 415.3 m. The period closed with a profit. Financial position in 2025: operating margin 2.5%; equity ratio 32.7%. Calculated from the filed figures above. Registered employees: 4334. Leadership in the official register: Kathinka Friis-Møller (managing director); Kathinka Friis-Møller (chair of the board); Gaute Houge (board member); Ingvil Rasten Fongod (board member); plus 5 further roles. 104 registered workplaces in Arendal, Bergen, Bodø, Brønnøysund, Drammen, Eidsvoll Verk and more. Official website https://www.compass-group.no/no (identity check: labelled organisation number); company-linked profiles on instagram, linkedin. Appears to be hiring: 5 active job ads with an exact employer match (Ernæringskokk til Montebello Hotell; Kantineleder; Kokk til personalrestaurant på Sixa). Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-11-12).
